Earl Spencer Makes New Claims About King Charles and Princess Diana's Death

Earl Spencer, brother of the late Princess Diana, has made new claims regarding King Charles and the circumstances surrounding Diana's death. Spencer alleges that King Charles, then Prince Charles, made a comment about forgetting Diana soon after her death. He also claims the late Queen responded 'tetchily' when informed about the crash. Spencer has stated he is telling the truth and has challenged King Charles to respond to his allegations. The claims are detailed in a new book by Earl Spencer.
